purpose: Short first-person distress, idioms and attributions in EN/MSA/Gulf; counters the length confound of Combined_Data and gives the Arabic head short inputs
excluded: CRISIS is never a training label here; rules own it (see resources/safety_eval_seeds.jsonl).
use: Train-only supplement. Clinician must confirm every HIGH row.
honest_limits: About 70 rows; a seed set, not a corpus.
split_policy: grouped, stratified by label; no group spans two splits
row_weights: synthetic rows carry weight 0.5; the field used to be absent, so loaders defaulted them to 1.0
